referrals.faqHowWorks: How does the referral program work?
referrals.faqHowWorks1: Share your unique referral link with friends and family.

referrals.faqHowMuch: How much can I earn from referrals?
referrals.faqHowMuchAnswer: You earn {{amount}} {{currency}} for each successful referral. The amount may vary based on current promotions. Check your referral dashboard for the latest reward amounts.
referrals.faqWhenRewards: When do I receive my referral rewards?
referrals.faqWhenRewardsAnswer: You receive your referral reward after the person you referred completes their first booking on Beautonomi. The reward is credited to your wallet and can be used for future bookings or withdrawn according to our payout policy.
referrals.faqSamePerson: Can I refer the same person multiple times?
referrals.faqSamePersonAnswer: No, each person can only be referred once. If someone has already signed up for Beautonomi, they cannot use your referral link to earn rewards.
referrals.faqTrack: How do I track my referrals?
referrals.faqTrackAnswer: You can track all your referrals, earnings, and pending rewards on this page. The dashboard shows your total referrals, successful referrals, and total earnings.
